rules.name: grasa-inputs-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT security_id, product_code, derivative_type, contract_month, vol1_id, underlying1_id, strike, strike1, maturity_date, barrier_type, barrier1_level, barrier1_rebate, barrier2_level FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs

SELECT security_id, product_code, derivative_type, contract_month, vol1_id, underlying1_id, strike, strike1, maturity_date, barrier_type, barrier1_level, barrier1_rebate, barrier2_level FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE business_unit = :bu AND status = 'Active'

SELECT vol_id, UPPER(call_put_id) AS call_put_id, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, MIN(strike) AS min_strike, MAX(strike) AS max_strike, ROUND(SUM(settle_vol), 6) AS sum_vol FROM dbsystemuat.settlement_vol_surf_table WHERE value_date = :cob AND vol_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT vol1_id FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs) GROUP BY vol_id, UPPER(call_put_id)

SELECT vol_id, UPPER(call_put_id) AS call_put_id, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, MIN(strike) AS min_strike, MAX(strike) AS max_strike, ROUND(SUM(settle_vol)::numeric, 6) AS sum_vol FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table WHERE value_date = :cob AND vol_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT vol1_id FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE business_unit = :bu AND status = 'Active') GROUP BY vol_id, UPPER(call_put_id)

SELECT underlying_id, settle_value, risk_free_rate, div_yield, settlement_date FROM dbsystemuat.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE value_date = :cob AND underlying_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying1_id FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs)

SELECT underlying_id, settle_value, risk_free_rate, div_yield, settlement_date FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE value_date = :cob AND underlying_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying1_id FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE business_unit = :bu AND status = 'Active')
